title: Stop a system service
summary: Stop a running system service or unit. This is useful when you need to temporarily halt a background process like a web server or database.

steps.explain: Stop the specified system unit. You need to know the exact name of the service (e.g., nginx.service).

placeholders.name: UNIT
placeholders.description: The name of the systemd unit or service to stop.

rollback.explain: Start the service again to restore its previous state. Note: The start command is not on this page, so consult the systemctl start documentation or use your desktop's service manager.

warnings: Stopping a critical system service may disrupt your desktop environment or network connectivity.
The service will not start automatically on reboot unless it is enabled.
